About.title: About me
About.eyebrow: Three years of daily automation practice
About.lead: My strength is not one specific framework, but structured problem-solving with automation, AI and verification — from the first idea to a checked result.
paragraphs: My path started with a strong signal: after my degree in Economic Cybernetics (a ZAB-recognized bachelor's), I took 1st place among about 6,000 participants in the RS School / EPAM preparation course — with pixel-perfect HTML/CSS work as my strongest discipline.

Since then, I have worked on browser automation every day for around three years — AI-assisted: I define the workflows, direct coding agents, verify behaviour in the real browser and debug through DevTools and network traffic analysis. The systems span more than 10,000 isolated browser profiles with their own network, identity and session configuration, with up to 10 sessions running concurrently. When an unstable workflow directly costs money, verification becomes a habit.

Today I focus that experience on web test automation. My public e2e suite (Playwright + TypeScript, Page Object Model, API contract tests, accessibility gate) tests this very website in CI — AI-assisted implementation, with scope, verification and debugging in my hands. I am looking for a QA / test automation role in a professional team.

motivationPoints: I turn unclear requirements into concrete work packages and functioning, tested solutions.
I do not treat AI as a black box: results are tested, questioned and improved iteratively.
I communicate knowledge gaps honestly and want to learn sound testing practices from experienced engineers.
